_comment: Canonical deep-link URL shapes. THE contract — docs/DEEP_LINKING.md v1.2 is its prose form. Every surface that emits or parses these URLs asserts against this file: the SPA (src/utils/deepLinks.ts), the MCP server, ask-chat exhibits, the sitemap generator, and the facts generator. Adding a shape here without updating DEEP_LINKING.md, or vice versa, is a bug. See docs/specs/future/setlist-deep-linking.md.
_why: Before this file existed the contract was enforced by a comment (workers/ask-chat/src/exhibits.ts: 'mirror docs/DEEP_LINKING.md'). That is how the superseded '&tab=setlists' sketch survived in the docs long enough to read as intended design.

setlist.notes: Keyed on concert date, which is globally unique across the archive. Never concert.id — those are row-order artifacts and a re-import that renumbers rows would break every shared link.
